name: Poker Cheat
source:
A travelling con man comes to town looking to cheat his way into easy money. He instead finds something unexpected when he happens upon a woman from his past.

[From [url=https://petejohnwilson.itch.io/poker-cheat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名旅行骗子来到镇上，希望通过欺骗手段轻松赚到钱。相反，当他遇到一个过去的女人时，他发现了一些意想不到的事情。

[来自[url=https://petejohnwilson.itch.io/poker-cheat]itch.io[/url]]
